mechanism_narrative: A persistent elevation in RESIDENTIAL mobility above baseline reflects sustained at-home behavior that substitutes for discretionary outings, suppressing RETAIL_REC over the following four weeks as households continue minimizing non-essential trips.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL has stayed between +14.3 and +15.9 for four consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL remaining elevated (>12) throughout the period.

mechanism_narrative: As outdoor temperatures drop in mid-November, a sharp week-on-week decline in PARKS mobility signals reduced willingness to be outside, which spills over into lower overall discretionary movement including retail and recreation visits over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls more than 10 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS dropped from -29.0 to -45.6 between t-3w and t-2w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline over the next 2 weeks even though PARKS drops more than 10 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week contraction in TRANSIT mobility exceeding 3 points signals newly tightened capacity restrictions or public caution following rising case counts, which directly reduces access to retail corridors and lowers RETAIL_REC within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 3 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT fell from -52.3 to -54.9 between t-3w and t-2w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises or stays flat in the week following a TRANSIT drop exceeding 3 points.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT indicate a compounding contraction in daily out-of-home routines - commuting and transit use jointly collapsing - which together suppress incidental retail foot traffic more strongly than either series alone, lowering RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both fall week-on-week simultaneously
evidence_refs: fact:both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT declined between t-3w and t-2w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 4 weeks despite concurrent declines in both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: Stable or rising GROCERY_PHARM mobility alongside falling RETAIL_REC indicates households are substituting essential shopping trips for discretionary retail visits, a behavioral reallocation that should persist and keep RETAIL_REC depressed relative to GROCERY_PHARM over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM stayed near -24 to -27 while RETAIL_REC stayed near -57 to -60
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises toward GROCERY_PHARM's level (gap narrows by more than 10 points) over the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The approach of Thanksgiving week historically drives a temporary surge in shopping-related outings despite ongoing restrictions, producing a short-lived uptick in RETAIL_REC within one week even as other mobility categories remain suppressed.
evidence_refs: fact:decision date 2020-11-15 is roughly one week before the Thanksgiving holiday period
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise in the week immediately preceding Thanksgiving relative to the prior week's mean.

mechanism_narrative: The oscillating weekly pattern in RETAIL_REC itself (alternating between roughly -57 and -60) suggests a mean-reverting process; when weekly RETAIL_REC deviates by more than 2 points from its 4-week average, it tends to revert toward that average over the subsequent two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC deviates more than 2 points from its own 4-week mean
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC alternated between -56.7, -60.1, -57.3, -59.6 over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC continues trending further from its 4-week mean rather than reverting over the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Under a regime of tightening restrictions signaled by concurrent declines in PARKS and TRANSIT, any further joint deterioration in these series indicates escalating public-health measures (e.g., renewed capacity limits or advisories) that will continue to depress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS and TRANSIT both declined between t-3w and t-2w before partially recovering
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 4 weeks even as PARKS and TRANSIT remain jointly depressed or worsen.
